name: gmod-content-installer-plus
description: A Garry's Mod content installer that downloads and mounts Valve game content through SteamCMD.

scripts.build: node prebuild.js && npx --no-install @yao-pkg/pkg -t node22-win-x64 main.js --config package.json -o bin/gmod-content-installer-plus.exe && node postbuild.js
scripts.test: node --check main.js && node --check util/steamcmd.js && node --check util/mount-config.js && node --check util/mount-depots.js && node --check util/content-packs.js && node test/mount-config.test.js && node test/mount-depots.test.js && node test/content-packs.test.js

author: zulc22
